description: Source code for a FastAPI-based backend service managing Robot Framework tests, including upload, retrieval, scheduling, and execution of tests and runs.

methods.name: _serialize_row_timestamps
methods.description: Converts datetime objects in a database row to ISO format strings, and parses 'tags' JSON string if present.

methods.name: list_tests
methods.description: Returns a list of uploaded tests with basic metadata.

methods.name: upload_test
methods.description: Handles uploading a .robot test file, storing it in MinIO, and creating a database record.

methods.name: get_test
methods.description: Retrieves metadata and test cases for a specific stored test.

methods.name: delete_test
methods.description: Deletes a test record and attempts to remove its file from MinIO.

methods.name: list_cases
methods.description: Extracts and returns test case names from a stored .robot file.

methods.name: get_test_schema
methods.description: Returns declared variables, usage, and a JSON schema for UI validation.

methods.name: list_all_runs
methods.description: Lists all test runs with optional filtering by status, date, and tags.

methods.name: list_runs
methods.description: Lists runs for a specific test with optional filters.

methods.name: run_test
methods.description: Schedules execution of a test, fetching test content and queuing background execution.

methods.name: get_test_case_required_schema
methods.description: Returns required variables for a specific test case, derived from test content.

methods.name: queue_test
methods.description: Queues a test run without starting execution, storing variables and cases.

methods.name: start_queued_run
methods.description: Starts a queued run by loading test content and scheduling background execution.

methods.name: list_queued_runs
methods.description: Lists queued runs, most recent first.

methods.name: get_run
methods.description: Retrieves metadata and results for a specific run.
